title: Major £8 billion investment to upgrade UK nuclear submarine availability and warfighting readiness
summary: Royal Navy submarines will get back to sea faster under a new multi-billion contract to improve their maintenance, strengthening the UK’s nuclear deterrent while backing British jobs and skills.

title: Suomeen kohdistui voimakasta GPS-häirintää samaan aikaan, kun drooni iski Sparta II -venäläisalukseen
summary: Häiriöt voivat vaikuttaa lentoliikenteen järjestelmiin, eikä niiden aiheuttajaa toistaiseksi tiedetä.

title: Russian embassy claims are nonsense, explains Latvia
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Latvia issued a statement on November 26th that essentially said that the latest claims made by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia are 'disinformation', i.e. complete nonsense.

title: Who are the five Lithuanians suspected of working for Russian state media?
summary: Lithuanian prosecutors have detained five people suspected of cooperating with Russian state media in exchange for money, allegedly spreading Kremlin propaganda and collecting and passing information of interest to a hostile foreign state.

title: Lithuania sees no need to close Russian border, new border guard chief says
summary: Lithuania currently sees no reason to close its border crossing points with Russia, the country’s newly appointed border guard chief Donatas Škarnulis said Wednesday, following Estonia’s decision to shut its crossings with Russia from December over a suspected sabotage plot linked to Russian military intelligence.

title: Terrorverdacht - zwei Iraker in Köln und Heidelberg festgenommen
summary: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat zwei Männer in Köln und Heidelberg festnehmen lassen. Sie sollen einer pro-iranischen Gruppe angehört und Anschläge geplant haben - möglicherweise auch einen auf eine Synagoge in Köln. Von H. Schmidt.

title: Podcast 15: Schlag gegen "Terror 18", Medikamentenmangel, Treffpunkte für Männer
summary: Jugendliche festgenommen - was wir über die rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" wissen. Die EU hat Maßnahmen gegen Mangel bei Medikamenten beschlossen. Helfen sogenannte Männerschuppen gegen Einsamkeit?
